_comment: The status chunk, once, for every language.
A11 carries a status as data in exactly one shape: a chunk of `mimetype`
whose payload is the concatenated-MessagePack (code, message, details)
record. Action dispatch/completion statuses, node aborts and the closure
marker a drained writer tees all use this one shape, so the encoders must
agree byte for byte. Each language builds these cases with its own helper
and asserts them against this file, so a divergence fails a test instead
`close_attribute` is the chunk-metadata attribute that marks a status as a
node closure marker rather than a value. It rides on the metadata, so a
marker's payload is byte-identical to the same status written plainly.
